en: vt. to make certain that something happens or is true; to protect something from harm; to guarantee something
ex: Please ensure that all the doors are locked before you leave.
離開前請確保所有門都已上鎖。

en: n. a move to a higher position or rank at work; the activity of advertising something to make people want to buy it; an effort to make something grow or succeed
ex: She was offered a promotion after two years at the company.
她在公司工作兩年後獲得了升遷機會。

en: n. a series of rulers from the same family; a period of time during which a country is ruled by the same family
ex: The Ming dynasty ruled China for nearly three hundred years.
明朝統治中國將近三百年。

en: a. deserving respect and approval; very good; deserving praise
ex: Her courage in the face of danger was truly admirable.
她面對危險時的勇氣真令人欽佩。

en: a. relating to everyone in the world or in a group; true or suitable in all situations; n. a general idea or principle
ex: Education is a universal human right.
教育是普世的人權。

en: n. a good quality or behavior in a person; a good or useful quality of something; moral goodness
ex: Patience is a virtue.
耐心是一種美德。

en: n. a competition to find the best player or team; the position or title of a champion; support for a cause
ex: Our team won the national championship last year.
我們隊去年贏得了全國冠軍。

en: vt. to take something out of a place or position; to take money out of a bank account; to stop taking part in something; vi. to move back or away from a place or situation
ex: I'd like to withdraw some money from my account.
我想從我的帳戶提一些錢。

en: n. a typical quality or feature of a person or thing; a. typical of a person or thing
ex: Honesty is her most notable characteristic.
誠實是她最顯著的特質。

en: n. the act of welcoming someone; the place in a hotel or office where visitors report on arrival; a formal party to welcome someone; the quality of the signals received on a radio or phone
ex: The hotel reception is open twenty-four hours a day.
飯店櫃台全天候二十四小時開放。

en: vt. to ask for advice or information from someone; to look at a book or document to find information; vi. to discuss something with someone before making a decision
ex: You should consult a doctor if the pain continues.
如果疼痛持續，你應該去看醫生。

en: n. tiny drops of water that form on the ground, leaves and other cool surfaces during the night; vt. to wet something with dew
ex: The grass was covered with dew in the early morning.
清晨草地上覆滿了露水。

en: a. feeling tired and ready to sleep; making you feel sleepy
ex: The medicine made me feel drowsy all afternoon.
這個藥讓我整個下午都昏昏欲睡。

en: n. the quality of being worthy of respect; a calm and serious manner; the feeling of pride in yourself
ex: He faced the difficult situation with dignity.
他以尊嚴面對這個艱難的處境。

en: a. able to be accepted or endured; fairly good; acceptable but not excellent
ex: The heat was tolerable once we sat in the shade.
一旦坐到陰涼處，熱度就還算可以忍受。

en: vt. to use up a resource such as energy or money; to eat or drink something; to destroy something completely; vi. to be used up or destroyed
ex: Cars consume a large amount of fuel.
汽車消耗大量燃料。

en: n. the quality of being honest and saying what you really feel or believe; a genuine feeling
ex: I doubt the sincerity of his apology.
我懷疑他道歉的誠意。

en: n. a group of words that has a different meaning from the meanings of the separate words; the way of speaking typical of a particular person or place
ex: "Break a leg" is an idiom that means good luck.
「Break a leg」是個表示祝你好運的習語。

en: n. a group of people who give advice or make decisions; a flat piece of wood, metal or other material that forms part of a wall or door; a board where the controls of a machine are located; vt. to cover a wall with panels
ex: A panel of experts will discuss the new policy.
一個專家小組將討論這項新政策。

en: n. the state of being calm and not worried; a period of rest; the act of making a rule or restriction less strict
ex: Yoga is a good form of relaxation after work.
瑜珈是下班後很好的放鬆方式。

en: a. exact and accurate in every detail; clearly stated; careful about small details
ex: Please give me the precise time of the meeting.
請告訴我會議的確切時間。

en: n. a series of planned activities to achieve a particular result, especially in politics or business; a series of military operations; vi. to take part in an organized effort to achieve a goal
ex: She is campaigning for a seat in parliament.
她正在為國會席位競選。

en: n. a long narrow band of color on a surface; a band of color that is different from the color around it; a badge on a military uniform that shows rank
ex: He wore a shirt with blue and white stripes.
他穿著一件藍白條紋的襯衫。

en: n. a person who is among the first to explore or settle a new area; a person who is among the first to develop new ideas; vt. to be the first to do or use something; vi. to be the first to do something
ex: He was a pioneer in the field of computer science.
他是電腦科學領域的先驅。

en: n. a type of dance performed on a stage, with graceful, formal movements and usually accompanied by music; a performance of this type of dance
ex: She has taken ballet lessons since she was five.
她從五歲起就學芭蕾舞。

en: vt. to crush something into small pieces or powder; to rub two surfaces together with force; vi. to make a harsh rubbing noise; to work hard at something boring; n. a boring and tiring task; a student who studies very hard
ex: He grinds fresh coffee beans every morning.
他每天早上都現磨咖啡豆。

en: n. the activity of making a product or person known to the public; the attention given to someone or something by newspapers and television
ex: The film got a lot of publicity before its release.
這部電影在上映前獲得很多宣傳。

en: a. happening once a year; calculated over a period of one year; n. a plant that lives for one year; a book published once a year
ex: The company holds an annual meeting every March.
公司每年三月舉辦年會。

en: n. a very old story that is often not true but explains the history of a place or person; a famous person who is admired for a particular skill; an explanation of the symbols on a map or chart
ex: The legend of King Arthur is known all over the world.
亞瑟王的傳說舉世聞名。
ph: a legend in one's own lifetime

en: n. a place on the internet where information about a particular subject, company or person can be found
ex: You can find more information on our website.
你可以在我們的網站上找到更多資訊。

en: n. a piece of jewelry worn around the wrist or arm
ex: She wore a gold bracelet on her left wrist.
她左手腕戴著一條金手鐲。

en: n. an act of showing how something works or is done; a public meeting held to protest against or support something; proof that something is true
ex: The chef gave a cooking demonstration to the class.
主廚為全班做了一場烹飪示範。

en: n. the things that are contained in something; the subject matter of a book, speech or website; the state of being happy and satisfied; a. satisfied with what you have; vt. to make someone feel happy and satisfied
ex: The content of the speech was very interesting.
這場演講的內容非常有趣。

en: a. strange or unusual in a way that may be unpleasant; belonging only to a particular person, place or thing; n. a property or privilege belonging only to one person or group
ex: There was a peculiar smell coming from the kitchen.
廚房傳來一股奇怪的味道。

en: a. having a lot of influence on how people think or behave; having the power to change things
ex: She is one of the most influential writers of her generation.
她是同世代最具影響力的作家之一。

en: n. the act of leaving a job or position; a letter saying you will leave your job; the feeling of accepting something unpleasant without complaining
ex: He handed in his resignation to the manager this morning.
他今天早上把辭呈交給了經理。

en: vt. to start something such as a new product or project; to send a rocket into space; to put a boat into water; n. the start of a new product or project; a large motorboat
ex: The company will launch a new smartphone next week.
公司下週將推出一款新智慧型手機。

en: n. words or ideas that have no meaning or are silly; foolish behavior; things that are not true
ex: Don't talk nonsense; that's not true at all.
別胡說八道，那根本不是真的。

en: a. having or showing new and original ideas; having a good imagination; relating to something imagined
ex: She is an imaginative child who loves to make up stories.
她是個富有想像力的孩子，愛編故事。

en: n. the way a person writes with a pen or pencil; writing produced by hand
ex: I can't read his handwriting; it's too messy.
我看不懂他的字，太潦草了。
